Logging
BIG-IP AS3 logs to
/var/log/restnoded/restnoded.log
using f5-logger from the framework.  BIG-IP AS3 supports multiple log levels.  The log entries contain a JSON block for easy search & reporting by external tools.

For audit logs in
/var/log/audit
, no matter your BIG-IP user account name, audit logs show all messages from
admin
and not the specific user name.
